qa.question: What do you do?
qa.answer: Backend AI engineer working on production LLM microservices and multi-agent RAG systems. Currently Associate Software Engineer – AI at DeltaShoppe, where I rotate across three concurrent client engagements.

qa.question: What are you working on right now?
qa.answer: I'm at DeltaShoppe as Associate Software Engineer – AI. Most of my work is on an AI therapy microservice for an Australian government healthcare client — Faster-Whisper + Phi-3.5-Mini (INT8) on CPU-only 15 GB AKS pods, 300+ daily sessions, event-driven audio pipeline on Azure Service Bus decoupling transcription and summarisation into background jobs.

qa.question: Tell me about the AI therapy microservice
qa.answer: Designed an AI therapy microservice for an Australian government healthcare client — 300+ daily sessions, with an event-driven audio pipeline on Azure Service Bus that decouples transcription and summarisation into background jobs. Deployed Faster-Whisper + Phi-3.5-Mini (INT8) CPU-only on 15 GB AKS pods; a multi-processing worker pool resolved lock contention and ONNX OOM failures. Includes JWKS token verification, encrypted audio at rest, dead-letter queues with retry logic, and MLflow observability.

qa.question: Tell me about the student companion / multi-tenant RAG system
qa.answer: Multi-tenant RAG system with pgvector, per-client isolation, and propositional chunking (~10:1 compression, 90% token reduction). Sliding-window memory with importance scoring cut tokens from 100K to 10K per session. Tool-injector pattern for per-user permission scoping across LLM tools, plus PII redaction middleware and audit logging. Azure DevOps CI/CD; retry/fallback across Groq/Mistral; load-tested at 5–10 concurrent sessions.

qa.question: Tell me about the fraud detection work
qa.answer: Real-time fraud detection for regulated retail banking. Event-driven pipeline on Kafka with PII masking across 6 fields and automated Suspicious Transaction Report filing to the regulator every 5 minutes. Monitored via Prometheus + Grafana (3 dashboards) with CRITICAL alerts on verification failures.

qa.question: What is GraphRAG-Causal?
qa.answer: GraphRAG-Causal is my final-year project — a graph-augmented framework for causal reasoning in news. It combines XML cause-effect annotation with multi-hop graph traversal, with an agentic CrewAI Flows extension that integrates a graph DB and web search for controllable causal inference. Stack: CrewAI Flows, FastAPI, Docker, Neo4j.

qa.question: What was the F1 score on GraphRAG-Causal?
qa.answer: 82.88% F1 / 80% accuracy on CausalNewsCorpus — comparable to a fine-tuned BERT-Large baseline, achieved without task-specific fine-tuning of the underlying LLM.

qa.question: What is IntentLens?
qa.answer: IntentLens — a 4-agent system (scraper, intent analyser, search agent, supervisor) that analyses 5,000+ customer reviews. Used LLM-as-judge evaluation to score agent outputs against ground-truth intent labels. Stack: CrewAI, Groq API, Streamlit.

qa.question: What's your tech stack?
qa.answer: Backend-heavy AI: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, AsyncIO, OAuth/JWT, Docker. LLM: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, Azure OpenAI, vLLM, Ollama. Cloud: Azure (AKS, DevOps, Blob Storage), AWS (boto3). Databases: PostgreSQL (pgvector), Neo4j (Cypher). ML: PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, Faster-Whisper. Messaging/observability: Azure Service Bus, Kafka, MLflow, Prometheus, Grafana.
